title: LOOK: VP Sara Duterte gathers political allies at OVP year-end thanksgiving brunch

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte takes a group selfie with guests during the Office of the Vice President’s (OVP) year-end thanksgiving brunch. Photo courtesy of Janella Ejercito Estrada/Facebook

Vice President Sara Duterte gathered political allies and supporters at the Office of the Vice President’s (OVP) year-end thanksgiving brunch, attended by former President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo and several political figures.

Photos shared by former undersecretary Janella Ejercito Estrada on Facebook showed Duterte taking a group selfie with guests, including Macapagal-Arroyo, Cagayan Vice Governor Manuel Mamba, former House deputy speaker and party-list Rep. Bernadette Herrera, Quezon City Rep. Bong Suntay, former Duterte Youth party-list representative Ronald Cardema and former Batangas Vice Governor Mark Leviste.
The gathering comes amid Duterte's ongoing political and legal challenges, including the impeachment proceedings against her.—MCG, GMA News
